name: Buy zogre brutal combat supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Investigate the Zogre outbreak for Grish

evidence.note: Get permission to enter the tombs.

name: Defeat the zombie and search the tombs

evidence.note: Search the skeleton and kill Brentle's zombie. Open the backpack for a knife and the tankard, find the torn page and pry open the coffin for its prism.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Brentle is defeated and the three clues are collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Ask Zavistic Rarve about the clues

evidence.note: Ring the Wizards' Guild bell for Zavistic. Entry to the guild is unnecessary.

name: Search Sithik's room and draw his portrait

evidence.note: Search the room for the books and drawing supplies. Retry the drawing if needed.

name: Have the innkeeper identify Sithik

evidence.note: Show the tankard and the accurate portrait. Get the portrait signed.

name: Report the evidence to Zavistic

evidence.note: Give the wizard the signed portrait and books. Receive the transformation potion.

name: Transform Sithik and question him

evidence.note: Put the potion in his tea, leave the room and return after he transforms. Ask about the undead and the disease cure.

name: Get the tomb key and learn about brutal arrows

evidence.note: Grish gives the tomb key and explains composite ogre equipment.

name: Defeat Slash Bash

evidence.note: Search the stand to start the fight. Use a composite ogre bow with brutal arrows. Reserve up to 35 shots in this route.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Slash Bash is defeated and the ogre artefact recovered.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Return the ogre artefact to Grish

evidence.note: Awards 2,000 XP each in Fletching, Ranged and Herblore, three Ourg bones and two Zogre bones. Unlocks brutal arrows and Relicym's balm.

name: Sell the black prism to Zavistic

evidence.note: Sell the surviving quest prism for 2,000 coins. The sale consumes the prism.

name: Buy Slayer gloves

evidence.note: Buy Slayer gloves from the Slayer equipment shop.

name: Speak to Pirate Pete and travel to Braindeath Island

evidence.note: Start Rum Deal at the dock north-east of the Ectofuntus. Pirate Pete transports you to the brewery.

name: Get the blindweed seed and farming tools

evidence.note: Speak to Braindeath. Pick up the farming tools from the cupboard in the brewery basement.

name: Plant the blindweed seed

evidence.note: Clear the patch and plant the seed. The five-minute planning clock allows travel and other work.

name: Pick the mature blindweed

evidence.note: Harvest when the growth timer is ready.

name: Show Braindeath the blindweed and load the hopper

evidence.note: Talk to Braindeath, climb upstairs to add the blindweed, then return and ask for the next ingredient.

name: Collect stagnant water

evidence.note: Fill the bucket from the pool past 50% Luke.

name: Add the stagnant water to the hopper

evidence.note: Pour the water into the hopper and retain the empty bucket.

name: Get the fishing gear and catch five sluglings

evidence.note: Braindeath supplies a bowl with a net attached. Catch five sluglings south of the brewery and return.

name: Load the pressure barrel and pull its lever

evidence.note: Add five catches and activate the pressure barrel.

name: Ask for the wrench and try the controls

evidence.note: Collect the wrench and try hitting the controls. Braindeath sends you to Davey.

name: Have Davey bless the wrench

evidence.note: Restore Prayer before the blessing. Davey checks at least 47 available Prayer points, which the model represents with the level gate and completion condition.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The player has at least 47 current Prayer points and Davey blesses the wrench.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Restore or boost Prayer points before speaking to Davey.

name: Defeat the evil spirit in the controls

evidence.note: Use the holy wrench on the control panel and defeat the spirit.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The evil spirit has been defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Get a fever spider body and add it to the hopper

evidence.note: Talk to Braindeath, defeat a fever spider in the basement and take its body upstairs to the hopper. Wear Slayer gloves to avoid disease.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A fever spider has been defeated and its body added to the hopper.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Fill a bucket at the tap and give Donnie the swill

evidence.note: Collect the unsanitary swill and take it to Donnie south of the brewery.

name: Report Donnie's response to Braindeath

evidence.note: Awards 7,000 Fishing, Farming and Prayer XP. The holy wrench was obtained earlier.

name: Agree to crew Bill Teach's ship

evidence.note: Speak to Bill Teach in the Green Ghost inn at Port Phasmatys.

name: Board the ship and set sail

evidence.note: Cross the gangplank and speak to Bill aboard ship.

name: Sabotage the enemy ship's gunpowder barrel

evidence.note: Collect the rope, fuse and tinderbox onboard. Swing across, light the fuse on the enemy barrel and return.

name: Patch and waterproof the three holes

evidence.note: Use the ship's repair locker and fix each hole with two planks, ten tacks and one swamp paste.

name: Bring ten plunder back to Bill's hold

evidence.note: Swing across and search the enemy hold until ten pieces of plunder are collected. Allow for respawns, then deposit it in Bill's hold.

name: Replace the broken cannon barrel

evidence.note: Use the spare cannon barrel from the gun locker.

name: Load and fire canisters at the enemy crew

evidence.note: Gather ammunition onboard. Load powder, ram it, load a canister, add a fuse, fire and clean the barrel. Repeat until Bill calls for cannonballs.

name: Fire the cannonballs and finish the voyage

evidence.note: Finish the fight and arrive at Mos Le'Harmless. Awards 7,000 Agility, Crafting and Smithing XP, and the book. Speak to Bill again for the coins.

name: Buy great brain robbery supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Speak to Brother Tranquility at the docks

evidence.note: Start at Mos Le'Harmless with Cabin Fever and Pirate Pete's rescue complete.

name: Repair the stairs beneath Harmony's statue

evidence.note: Enter the underwater tunnel in the diving gear and repair the far staircase with four planks and a nail reserve.

name: Look through the peephole

evidence.note: Discover Mi-Gor's work through the peephole.

name: Tell Brother Tranquility what you saw

evidence.note: Return through the tunnel and report to Brother Tranquility.

name: Find and read the prayer book

evidence.note: Search the southwestern bookcase in the Edgeville Monastery.

name: Recite the prayer on Harmony

evidence.note: Wear a holy symbol and recite the prayer to protect yourself from the gas. Speak to Brother Tranquility.

name: Ask Dr Fenkenstrain to help the monks

evidence.note: Talk to Fenkenstrain on the upper floor of his castle.

name: Arrange shipment with Rufus

evidence.note: Wear the Ring of charos to obtain the crate parts and instructions. The activated ring also works.

name: Build the crate and pack it with ten wooden cats

evidence.note: Build the crate and its floor near the doctor, pack it with wooden cats and summon Rufus for inspection.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The shipment crate is built and inspected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Dismiss any following pet before Rufus checks the shipment.

name: Attach the shipping order to Fenkenstrain's crate

evidence.note: Send Fenkenstrain to Harmony Island.

name: Ask Fenkenstrain which surgical tools he needs

evidence.note: Find the doctor in the windmill basement.

name: Retrieve the fuse and powder keg

evidence.note: Equip diving gear and search the powder ship for the fuse and keg. Take the tinderbox there if needed.

name: Blow open the church door

evidence.note: Put the keg and fuse against the door and light it.

name: Recover the surgical tools from sorebones

evidence.note: Defeat sorebones until they drop the cranial clamp, brain tongs, three bell jars and thirty skull staples.

planned_outcome.success_condition: All the surgical items have been recovered.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Give the doctor the surgical tools

evidence.note: Hand in the tools and hammer to help restore the monks.

name: Talk to the restored Brother Tranquility

evidence.note: Receive the monks' blessing before confronting Mi-Gor.

name: Defeat Barrelchest and take the broken anchor

evidence.note: Confront Mi-Gor and defeat Barrelchest. Collect the broken anchor after the fight.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Barrelchest is defeated and the broken anchor collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Report back to Brother Tranquility

evidence.note: Awards 6,000 Prayer XP, 2,000 Construction XP, 3,000 Crafting XP and a held 5,000 XP lamp. Keep the prayer book and broken anchor already obtained.

name: Have Smith repair the Barrelchest anchor

evidence.note: Smith repairs the broken anchor for 230,000 coins after the quest.

name: Buy burgh repair supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Buy burgh delivery supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Speak to Veliaf in the Myreque hideout

evidence.note: Veliaf asks you to establish a new base in Burgh de Rott.

name: Put food in the chest outside Burgh de Rott

evidence.note: Give the town one piece of food to gain access.

name: Clear the inn trapdoor and basement rubble

evidence.note: Speak to Razvan, then mine the blocked trapdoor and use the spade and buckets to remove the rubble. Empty the buckets outside.

name: Repair the shop roof and wall

evidence.note: Repair the roof and wall with six planks and 24 nails. Speak to Aurel about the delivery crate.

name: Fill Aurel's crate and restock the shop

evidence.note: Give Aurel ten bronze axes, three tinderboxes and ten of the raw fish or snails he requested. This route reserves both possible foods and does not credit the unused food.

name: Repair the bank and recruit Cornelius

evidence.note: Repair the booth and wall, then ask Cornelius to be the banker.

name: Repair and relight the furnace

evidence.note: Talk to Razvan, use two steel bars to repair the furnace, add coal and light it.

name: Defeat Gadderanks and his vampyre juvinates

evidence.note: Investigate the shop and protect Wiskit. Use a weapon that can damage vampyre juvinates. Speak to Gadderanks after the fight and receive his hammer from Aurel.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Gadderanks and the two juvinates have been defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Escort Ivan Strom to Paterdomus

evidence.note: Discuss the escort with the Myreque, keep Ivan alive and defeat the juvinates on the short route.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Ivan Strom reaches Paterdomus alive.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring food for Ivan and allow extra time for his escort.

name: Ask Drezel for the library key

evidence.note: Ask Drezel about Ivandis and the temple library.

name: Read The Sleeping Seven

evidence.note: Find the book about Ivandis and read it.

name: Take a clay impression from Ivandis's tomb

evidence.note: Use soft clay on the coffin to make the rod mould.

name: Make and enchant the silvthrill rod

evidence.note: Use the repaired furnace with the mould, then cast Lvl-1 Enchant on the rod.

name: Lower the enchanted rod into the River Salve

evidence.note: Use a rope to dip the enchanted rod into the Salve at the well.

name: Give the Rod of Ivandis to Veliaf

evidence.note: Awards 2,000 Attack, Strength, Defence and Crafting XP. Opens Temple Trekking.

name: Buy souls bane supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Ask Launa about her family

evidence.note: Agree to search for Launa's family in the rift.

name: Secure a rope and enter the rift

evidence.note: Attach the rope and climb down into the anger room.

name: Clear the anger room

evidence.note: Take the matching weapon from the rack for each angry creature. Enter the next chamber when the rage meter fills.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The anger room is cleared and its exit opens.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Defeat five fear reapers

evidence.note: Search different holes to reveal the reapers. Use the exit after five kills.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Five fear reapers have been defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Find and defeat the real confusion beasts

evidence.note: Identify the beast that takes damage. Repeat until the real exit is revealed.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The real exit in the confusion room has opened.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Defeat the hopeless creatures and cross the bridge

evidence.note: Defeat each creature three times and cross the bridge.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The bridge appears and the player crosses it.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Defeat Tolna's three heads

evidence.note: Defeat all three heads and speak to Tolna to return to the surface.

planned_outcome.success_condition: All three heads are defeated and Tolna returns to normal.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Speak to Tolna outside the rift

evidence.note: Awards 500 Defence XP, 500 Hitpoints XP and 500 coins. Unlocks repeat access to the rift.

name: Enter Tolna's rift after A Soul's Bane

evidence.note: Climb into Tolna's rift after quest completion to record the Varrock Medium task.

name: Buy rag and bone man supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Get the bone list from the Odd Old Man

evidence.note: Accept the collection list. The eight monsters drop their quest bones after starting.

name: Collect giant rat bone

evidence.note: Defeat the listed monster and pick up its quest drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The quest bone is collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Collect unicorn bone

evidence.note: Defeat the listed monster and pick up its quest drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The quest bone is collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Collect bear ribs

evidence.note: Defeat the listed monster and pick up its quest drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The quest bone is collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Collect ram skull

evidence.note: Defeat the listed monster and pick up its quest drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The quest bone is collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Collect goblin skull

evidence.note: Defeat the listed monster and pick up its quest drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The quest bone is collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Collect big frog leg

evidence.note: Defeat the listed monster and pick up its quest drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The quest bone is collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Collect monkey paw

evidence.note: Defeat the listed monster and pick up its quest drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The quest bone is collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Collect giant bat wing

evidence.note: Defeat the listed monster and pick up its quest drop.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The quest bone is collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Buy eight jugs of vinegar from Fortunato

evidence.note: Ask Fortunato about the Odd Old Man, then buy eight jugs for eight coins.

name: Clean the eight bones on the pot-boiler

evidence.note: Add vinegar and a bone to each pot. Burn one log per bone in the boiler, then remove the pot when its bone is clean. Timing assumes staying at the boiler and includes the successive heating waits.

name: Give the Odd Old Man the clean bones

evidence.note: Awards 500 Cooking XP and 500 Prayer XP. Unlocks the second bone list.

name: Buy skippy supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Brew nettle tea for Skippy

evidence.note: Pick nettles with gloves and boil them in a bowl of water over a lit log.

name: Sober up Skippy with a bucket of water

evidence.note: Use the bucket on Skippy and keep the empty bucket.

name: Give Skippy nettle tea

evidence.note: Speak to Skippy and give him nettle tea.

name: Mix the hangover cure

evidence.note: Mix chocolate dust into the milk, then add snape grass.

name: Give Skippy the hangover cure

evidence.note: Learn how to draw out mogres with fishing explosives. Fighting them requires 32 Slayer.

name: Buy a fishing explosive

evidence.note: Slayer equipment shops stock fishing explosives.

name: Kill a mogre at Mudskipper Point

evidence.note: Throw a fishing explosive at an ominous fishing spot and defeat the mogre.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The summoned mogre is defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Claim Bill Teach's 10,000 coins

evidence.note: Talk to Bill Teach once more after the quest to collect the payment.
